## Description

Uses ATR-derived upper/lower bands to define the active trend and trigger direction changes when price crosses the band.

## Where it may fit

Persistent directional moves with volatility-adjusted trailing exits; may lag or whipsaw in sideways markets.

## Vehicles

Equity/sector ETFs, stocks, futures, FX, crypto; CTA-style trend sleeves.

## Required data

OHLC bars, ATR lookback and multiplier; corporate-action-adjusted prices for equities.

## Caveats

Indicator definition is not proof of an edge; tune parameters only with walk-forward tests and realistic costs.
